decisive_items: Immunohistochemical staining: Positive for ACTH in 30-40% of invasive tumor cells
response.rationale: The patient has clinical and biochemical Cushing syndrome with elevated ACTH, and the parotid malignancy is ACTH-positive, indicating ectopic ACTH production. R5 best captures both the syndrome and its cause; R1 identifies the tumor but omits the Cushing syndrome, and R2 only names the syndrome.

rejected.why: Names only Cushing syndrome without identifying the ectopic ACTH-producing parotid tumor as the cause.
Salivary gland neoplasm is too nonspecific and does not explain the ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome.
Primary adrenal insufficiency is contradicted by elevated serum and urinary cortisol and elevated ACTH.
Primary parotid gland malignancy describes the tumor but omits the ectopic ACTH secretion and Cushing syndrome.
